## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
Risk-on: low volatility, mixed breadth. Vol: 18.1%. Breadth: 3/8 sectors positive.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Heavy Industry RECOVERY: KRDMD (1W: +13.71% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +9.19% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND. Banking RECOVERY: YKBNK (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.12%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND. Transportation RECOVERY: THYAO (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.65%) BELOW TREND (lagging within group).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Retail & Food BELOW TREND: MGROS (1W: -14.59% | 1M: -11.57%) BELOW TREND, AEFES (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND. Technology & Telecom BELOW TREND: TTKOM (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND. Energy & Chemicals CORRECTION: TUPRS (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +36.20%) ABOVE TREND but sector weak overall.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
KRDMD (1W: +13.71% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +9.19% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND; TUPRS (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +36.20%) ABOVE TREND; OYAKC (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND; TKFEN (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +63.75%) ABOVE TREND.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
MGROS (1W: -14.59% | 1M: -11.57%) BELOW TREND; AEFES (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND; CCOLA (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND; TRALT (1W: -8.65% | 1M: -2.29%) BELOW TREND; TRMET (1W: -8.30% | 1M: +7.02%) CORRECTION.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
KRDMD (1W: +13.71% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND; MGROS (1W: -14.59% | 1M: -11.57%) BELOW TREND; ASELS (1W: +9.19% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND; AEFES (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND; TUPRS (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +36.20%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Selective recovery; favor larger-cap lenders with positive 1M confirmation. GARAN (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +0.08%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.12%) ABOVE TREND, AKBNK (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.59%) RECOVERY, ISCTR (1W: +2.39% | 1M: -10.73%) RECOVERY, VAKBN (1W: +4.62% | 1M: -0.65%) RECOVERY.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Heavy industry leading on cyclical bounce but 1M divergence remains. KRDMD (1W: +13.71% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND, ASELS (1W: +9.19% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND, EREGL (1W: +2.87% | 1M: -10.39%) RECOVERY, FROTO (1W: +2.07% | 1M: -5.50%) RECOVERY, ARCLK (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Mixed: TUPRS and OYAKC show momentum but sector breadth is weak. TUPRS (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +36.20%) ABOVE TREND, OYAKC (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND, SISE (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -12.58%) BELOW TREND, TRMET (1W: -8.30% | 1M: +7.02%) CORRECTION.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Risk-on bias: overweight cyclical heavy industry and selective banks (GARAN, YKBNK), trim Retail & Technology exposure and protect gains in long-duration losers; keep stops tight on names with 1M weakness.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
TUPRS (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +36.20%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through; KRDMD (1W: +13.71% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation; TKFEN (1W: +4.64% | 1M: +63.75%) ABOVE TREND on quant signals; ASELS (1W: +9.19% | 1M: +10.67%) ABOVE TREND; MGROS (1W: -14.59% | 1M: -11.57%) BELOW TREND as downside risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Construction & REIT CORRECTION (TKFEN outlier); Heavy Industry RECOVERY for cyclical plays; Retail & Food BELOW TREND for downside risk and earnings sensitivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Monitor XU100 momentum vs recent swing high and 20-day trend for risk-on continuation; catalysts: domestic CPI and CBRT commentary, oil price moves (TUPRS sensitivity), and upcoming corporate updates/earnings.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low-volatility, risk-on tape with mixed sector participation: heavy industry and select banks lead while retail and tech notably lag. Trade selectively—ride momentum in TUPRS/KRDMD/TKFEN and protect positions in structurally weak retail and telecom names.
